description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2041/30 of 20.10.2017, Cad. Map No. 520001, Homagama D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcel numbers, ownership status (changing from "State" to "Private"), access rights, and administrative boundaries for various land parcels in different locations. The content is purely land and property-related, focusing on title registration amendments rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
